subject: english
prompt: Read: 'Nora put the seedlings near the window. After a week, they grew taller.' Why did Nora put them there?（學習主題：理解短文訊息書信主要內容；情境代碼 81a8）

options.text: To make them dry. (for the 理解短文訊息書信主要內容 practice)

answer.explanation: 窗邊通常有光，且後文提到植物長高，最合理推論是為了取得光線。
